title: Place data layer + list page with create/edit form
description: Scaffold the places feature module in dispatch-ui. Define TypeScript interfaces for Place. Create place API client functions using axiosInstance. Set up Redux place entity module using createEntityModule from @mocho/ui/redux. Register place entities in the root store (reducer + saga). Build the place list page with DataGrid (using existing DataGrid + ActionsCell from @mocho/ui) with search, facility type filter, state filter, and pagination. Build place create/edit FormDialog with 3 sections (Location, Facility Details, Contact & Intelligence). Add Places item to Fleet nav group in sidebar. Fleet nav group and routes structure should already exist from fleet-management — extend it with Places.
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript interfaces defined: Place, CreatePlaceInput, UpdatePlaceInput with all fields matching Prisma schema including FacilityType (16 values), DockType (4 values), GeoSource enums
Place API functions: getPlaces(params), getPlace(id), createPlace(data), updatePlace(id, data), deletePlace(id) — all using axiosInstance
Redux place entity module created using createEntityModule from @mocho/ui/redux with standard CRUD operations
Place entity registered in store: entities.places in rootReducer, place sagas in rootSaga
Places route registered: /fleet/places (list), /fleet/places/:id (detail — page built in FE-002)

PlaceListPage renders DataGrid with columns: name (clickable link to detail), city/state combined, facilityType badge, associated contact name, appointmentRequired badge (Yes/No chip), actions (view/edit/delete)
DataGrid supports server-side pagination (page/limit params), search input with debounce (matches name/city/state), facilityType filter dropdown, state filter dropdown
Default sort: createdAt desc; sortable columns: name, city, state, facilityType, createdAt

PlaceFormDialog uses Formik + Yup with 3 Accordion sections: Location (name required, address, address2, city required, state required as 2-char select, zip, lat/lng read-only with manual override toggle), Facility Details (facilityType select with 16 options, dockType select with 4 options, operatingHours, receivingHours, appointmentRequired toggle, lumperRequired toggle, ppeRequired toggle), Contact & Intelligence (contactId as searchable Contact dropdown, contactName, contactPhone, contactEmail, checkInProcedures textarea, notes textarea)
Lat/Lng fields display as read-only with 'Auto (city centroid)' label; manual override toggle switches geoSource to MANUAL and makes fields editable
Places item added under Fleet nav group in sidebar
All styling uses MUI sx prop; no CSS modules or styled-components
At least one test: PlaceListPage.test.tsx renders page title and DataGrid using renderWithTheme pattern
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
